scenes.title: Six Forty-Five
scenes.summary: At dawn Pratap draws Kavya a street map to the old hardware shop across the bridge before the guests wake up.

scenes.title: The Blue Door
scenes.summary: Across the bridge Kavya calls Pratap from the square to check the last turn and buys two matching brass valves.

scenes.title: Hot Cinnamon Rolls
scenes.summary: Downstairs Diya and Mohan tempt early-rising Sudha with fresh cinnamon rolls before anyone turns on a cold tap.

scenes.title: Down in the Cellar
scenes.summary: In the basement Pratap and Kavya fit the new brass valve and bring hot water roaring back through the haveli.

scenes.title: Five-Star Showers
scenes.summary: Kabir praises the hot shower at breakfast while flustered Mohan accidentally reveals that they saw his notebook.

scenes.title: The Acoustic Architect
scenes.summary: Under the courtyard tree, Kabir shows Kavya and Diya his sketches: he studies quiet courtyard acoustics, not hotel stars.

scenes.title: Sunlight on the Tag
scenes.summary: While airing out the hallway cupboard, Pratap sets down the blue suitcase and Sudha recognises the Champa Lane address in bright daylight.

scenes.title: The Boy on the Stairs
scenes.summary: In the courtyard Sudha describes the quiet younger brother listening from the stairs just as Kabir walks down and hears her.
